d: Hair and eyes are completely obscured by a helmet, tactical goggles, and a face mask. This individual appears to be a mature adult with a sturdy, athletic build. The outfit is a desert-camo tactical uniform in shades of tan and beige, featuring a heavy brown chest rig with red accents, a utility belt with multiple pouches, black combat boots, and a tan helmet. Signature details include a large black shoulder-mounted mortar tube, black tactical gloves, and a tan scarf wrapped around the neck.
